title: Research
description: SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) have taken various research initiatives over the years to mobilize the available knowledge resources for research and also, to come up strongly with innovative solutions.

overview.heading: Overview
paragraphs: SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) have taken various research initiatives over the years to mobilize the available knowledge resources for research and also, to come up strongly with innovative solutions.
bullets: Committed to fostering and furthering research excellence
Specially focused on emerging areas of great potential like Nanotechnology, Bioengineering, Energy, Environment, Materials and Embedded systems among others
Actively involved in research projects that have nation building and public cause at their heart like for instance rural healthcare, among others.

mission: Provide excellent research culture and infrastructure
Serve as a platform for strong interdisciplinary collaborations and knowledge sharing
Publish research findings in high quality journals of international repute
Create scientifically profound human resources for academic & industrial research
Promote industrial collaborations involving active and mutually beneficial R & D projects

directorate.heading: Directorate of Research
directorate.paragraph: Research is an integral and important feature of learning endeavors at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST).

paragraphs: SRM Institute of Science and Technology organizes Conferences, Seminars and Workshops periodically. These activities and forums help expose young minds to the latest innovations and scientific trends, thereby generating an interest in research.
Students are also encouraged to take up innovative, socially relevant research projects. Such projects are funded by SRM Institute of Science and Technology.

policies.text: Policy on Chemical and Hazardous Waste disposal
Institutional Code of Ethics for Research

funded_research.title: Funded Research
funded_research.text: SRMIST facilitates research pursuits of our faculty members, scholars and students at scale. There is a dedicated focus on ensuring funding is in place so that research projects and studies progress satisfactorily. Incentives in the form of awards and prizes are given out to those demonstrating excellence in research.

funded_research.title: Collaborations
funded_research.text: Research collaborations with our foreign colleagues are crucial to the success of our global activities involving faculties and students.

central_facilities.name: IIISM
central_facilities.full: Interdisciplinary Institute of Indian System of Medicine
central_facilities.text: To promote the research in the field of traditional system of Indian Medicine, including Siddha, Ayurveda and Unani, IIISM was established in 2008.

central_facilities.name: REACH
central_facilities.full: Center for Research in Environment, Sustainability Advocacy and Climate CHange
central_facilities.text: REACH was initiated at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur, Tamil Nadu to support and enhance a cohesive university-wide environment of research excellence.

central_facilities.name: NRC
central_facilities.text: The Nanotechnology Research Center (NRC) with its state-of-the-art facilities is committed to the responsible development of nanotechnology as an important part of its environmental, health and safety research strategy.

central_facilities.name: CACR
central_facilities.text: The Center for Advanced Concrete Research (CACR) was started in the year 2010, to carry out interdisciplinary research in the field of concrete.

central_facilities.name: SRM-DBT Platform
central_facilities.text: Established in collaboration with the Department of Biotechnology, Govt. of India: SRM-DBT Partnership Platform for Contemporary Research Services and Skill Development in Advanced Life Science Technologies.

central_facilities.name: Medical Research Centre
central_facilities.text: SRMIST’s MRC, established in 2008, promotes research in medical & allied sciences.

central_facilities.name: Center for Statistics
central_facilities.text: SRMIST’s Centre for Statistics is the hub of Statistical Training, Research and Consultancy.

central_facilities.name: Earthquake Research Cell
central_facilities.text: Earthquake Research Cell (ERC) established in 2012 to decipher causes for origin, occurrence and prediction of Earthquake by better understanding the geodynamical behavior of this natural disaster on the globe.

central_facilities.name: HPCC
central_facilities.text: A supercomputer facility for research work, with computational capacity far above a general-purpose computer.

central_facilities.name: SCIF
central_facilities.text: SCIF portal consolidates the state-of-the-art research facilities available under the Directorate of Research in SRMIST and allows users to directly request & reserve time for use.
